tasks.label: 1. venv + deps
tasks.command: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install numpy matplotlib pytest pybind11 ruff

tasks.label: 3. build bindings
tasks.detail: Builds the pybind11 module and drops it next to odc_sim so imports resolve.
tasks.command: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DODC_BUILD_PYTHON=ON -DODC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -Dpybind11_DIR=$(.venv/bin/python -c 'import pybind11; print(pybind11.get_cmake_dir())') && cmake --build build -j && cp build/omni_drive_core*.so python/

tasks.label: Lint (ruff + clang-format)
tasks.command: .venv/bin/ruff check python tools tests && find cpp bindings ros2_ws -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.hpp' | xargs clang-format --dry-run --Werror
